title: Act I walk strips
note: Eighteen new 8-frame walk strips cut from the approved stills by tools/walk_cycle.py (frame 0 = the still, every pixel an approved one). Per strip: the still, the strip at 1x and 4x, and a GIF walking in place at 4x. Left as stills on purpose: the Cathedral Horror stone form (it never moves).

images.title: Corpse Abomination
images.description: Corpse Abomination. Heavy stomp: both huge fists ride with the body, only the two short legs step (3 px spread, 2 px lift).

images.title: Bone Colossus
images.description: Bone Colossus. The club arm and the loincloth streak ride with the body; two bone legs step (2 / 2).

images.title: Corpse Catapult
images.description: Corpse Catapult. A wheeled cart cannot turn its wheels without a redraw, so it rocks: the body dips and each side's wheels take turns riding up a 1 px bump.

images.title: Ossuary Engine
images.description: Ossuary Engine. Same rocking cart rig as the Catapult (rear wheel, then front wheel and hull).

images.title: Crypt Gargoyle
images.description: Crypt Gargoyle. Wing flap only (the wing tips touch the top row, so the body cannot bob): the big left wing drops 4 px at its tip and rises, twice per cycle.

images.title: Cathedral Horror
images.description: Cathedral Horror. Both wings flap (5 px tip drop), hinged where they meet the body. The stone form stays a still (it never moves).

images.title: Frost Wraith
images.description: Frost Wraith. Glide like the Banshee: the ragged hem sways 2 px forward and back, the body dips.

images.title: Winter Revenant
images.description: Winter Revenant. Glide: hem sway 2 px, the lightning staff above the hip rides with the body.

images.title: Profane Bishop
images.description: Profane Bishop. Walks on its two hem lobes like the Mender and Warder; the crook rides with the body.

images.title: Lich
images.description: Lich. Not in the audit list but the same gap: walks on its robe lobes like the Mage; the staff and orb ride with the body.

images.title: Sanctified Sentinel
images.description: Sanctified Sentinel. Armoured stride: sword arm above the hip rides with the body, the groin tassel is rigid, two legs step (2 / 2).

images.title: Radiant Inquisitor
images.description: Radiant Inquisitor. Robed walk on the hem lobes (1 / 1), like the Chaplain.

images.title: High Confessor
images.description: High Confessor. Robed walk (1 / 1); the crook is rigid down to the hem.

images.title: Sun Paladin
images.description: Sun Paladin. Armoured stride (1 / 1); the lance on the left and the shield bottom are rigid.

images.title: Cathedral Guardian
images.description: Cathedral Guardian. Huge slow stride (3 px spread, 2 px lift); both fists hang above the hip and move only with the dip.

images.title: Reckoning Inquisitor
images.description: Reckoning Inquisitor. Robed walk (1 / 1) on the hem lobes; the wide sleeves ride with the body.

images.title: Sir Alaric
images.description: Sir Alaric. Heavy boss stride (2 / 2): the hammer, tabard and cape ride with the body, the boots step.

images.title: Marshal Vael
images.description: Marshal Vael. Boss stride (2 / 2): the flaming sword, tower shield and tabard ride with the body, the left leg and the right boot under the shield step.
